missing_evidence: Payment service server-side latency/error metrics or spans for /v1/authorizations
Order service logs/spans showing where the 2s timeout budget is consumed
candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout), and order's own call to payment also times out at ~2s; payment is the slow downstream causing cascading checkout failure.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side spans or metrics; payment latency inferred from order's ReadTimeout, not directly observed.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by transport ReadTimeouts on gateway->order and order->payment, each ~2s, while inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. Consistent with downstream payment latency propagating to checkout. Payment-side telemetry is absent, so confidence is moderate.
